verdict.rationale: Drata's own docs claim connections to systems, including on-premise tools, that "automate evidence collection". It also documents monitoring tests and a read-only device agent that reads security settings such as screensaver lock and antivirus. Community users confirm devices show up as noncompliant in the dashboard, which implies ongoing machine-gathered checks. Most of this evidence is page titles or one-line marketing claims, though, and nothing shows scheduled collection cadence or timestamped artifacts replacing screenshots and CSVs. missing for 10: documented collection schedule/frequency, timestamped evidence artifacts, detail on what connections actually collect, independent hands-on corroboration of automated evidence replacing manual uploads.
